stories.title: Family searches for answers in wake of Port Hardy woman's death outside ER
stories.summary: Courtney McCowan, 48, had been sick for days and was rapidly deteriorating when a friend drove her to the hospital in Port Hardy, but the doors to the ER were locked for the night.

stories.title: The Doobie Brothers to make rare Victoria appearance in 2027
stories.summary: There’s a good chance their concert at the Save-on-Foods Memorial Centre on Aug. 23 could be the band’s Victoria debut.

stories.title: Ousted leader Hasina plans to return to Bangladesh from exile on Dec. 16, spokesperson says
stories.summary: DHAKA, Bangladesh (AP) — Ousted Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina plans to return home from exile in India on Dec. 16, the day the country celebrates as Victory Day when it won independence after a war with Pakistan.

stories.title: New film adaptation of the sacred Hindu epic Ramayana sparks debate over authenticity
stories.summary: LOS ANGELES (AP) — For many, the Ramayana is not just an epic with gods and superhumans shooting arrows, battling demons and zipping around in flying chariots.

stories.title: Leafs rally to beat Islanders 4-2, snap nine-game losing skid
stories.summary: ELMONT — The Toronto Maple Leafs spotted the New York Islanders a 2-0 lead on Monday and it appeared as if the Canadian visitors were on their way to a 10th straight loss.

stories.title: Ullmark leads Senators to 2-1 win over Flames
stories.summary: OTTAWA — Linus Ullmark continued his impressive start to the season on Monday, making 34 saves to lead the Ottawa Senators to a 2-1 victory over the Calgary Flames.

stories.title: Kuemper stops 29 shots as Kings beat Canadiens 2-1 in Larkin's debut
stories.summary: MONTREAL — Darcy Kuemper stopped 29 shots as the Los Angeles Kings spoiled Dylan Larkin’s Montreal debut with a 2-1 victory Monday night. Alex Laferriere and Trevor Moore scored as Los Angeles (8-12-2) won its third game in four outings.
